title: WHO: chronic obstructive pulmonary disease killed about 3.6 million people in 2023
summary: The fact sheet ranks chronic obstructive pulmonary disease third in 2023, about 6 percent of deaths, 3.6 million.
body: WHO's causes-of-death fact sheet says chronic obstructive pulmonary disease was the third leading cause of death in 2023, about 6 percent of total deaths, or 3.6 million. It also says that in 2023 this disease was not among the top ten causes in low-income countries, while it ranked in the top ten in the other income groups the sheet uses. Both sentences are on the sheet.
